seo.title: Tree Identifier — Learn how to care for what grows in your yard
seo.description: Take a photo of a tree, a shrub or a fruit tree: find out what it is, how to care for it, and what's wrong when it looks sick. Free app for iPhone and Android from the team behind Plant Tea.

items.a: Tree Identifier is free to download. Identification, health checks and the AI tree expert are part of Premium, a paid subscription (weekly or yearly). The price is shown in the app before you subscribe, and you can cancel anytime in your App Store or Google Play account settings.

Trees, shrubs, palms, conifers and fruit trees. You can photograph a leaf, the bark, a flower, a fruit or the whole tree, and bark and buds work in winter too, when the leaves are gone. The app also includes an encyclopedia of 160 trees and shrubs.
No account needed. The app is available in 12 languages.
Results come from an AI analysis of your photos and are indicative. Never eat a plant on the word of an app alone, and ask a certified arborist before felling a tree or doing major work on it.

items.q: Is the toxicity info veterinary or medical advice?
items.a: No. It's general information with sources. If you think a pet or a child ate a plant, contact a vet or a poison control center right away.
Plant Tea is made by the Tree Identifier team.

features.title: What the app does
features.intro: Know what it is, how to care for it, and what to do when something looks wrong.

items.title: Care, month by month
items.text: Light, water, soil, pruning and feeding for your species, with a month-by-month care calendar and reminders.

items.title: Is my tree sick?
items.text: Photograph the leaves, bark or branches to get a health check: likely problems, clear treatment steps, and how to prevent it next time.

items.title: Know what it is
items.text: Up to 3 photos per scan: leaf, bark, flower, fruit or the whole tree. Bark and buds work in winter, when the leaves are gone.

items.title: Ask a tree expert
items.text: Chat with an AI tree expert about pruning, planting, pests or any tree question.

items.title: Free tools
items.text: A light meter to find the right spot, a watering helper, tree age, tree height and an encyclopedia of 160 trees and shrubs.

features.premium_note: Identification, health checks and the tree expert are part of Premium, a paid subscription.
